learning_outcomes.text: Acquire knowledge about entrepreneurship theory and the evaluation of business functions for small and medium-sized enterprises.
Be able to brainstorm about the process of starting a business/establishing an enterprise, starting a new business, and acquiring an existing business.
Be able to create a business and marketing plan.
Be able to conduct financial planning for entrepreneurs and small businesses.
Acquire knowledge about the entrepreneurial investment model.
Learn the concept of corporate entrepreneurship.

syllabus_topics: Entrepreneurship, Concept, Importance and Classification of Entrepreneurship, Problems in Entrepreneurship Research
Entrepreneurship Process and Interaction with the Environment
The Entrepreneur as an Individual and their Characteristics
Business startup/establishment process, establishing a new business, acquiring an existing business
Business model, its concept and economic structure of the business model
Business and marketing plan, Financial planning for entrepreneurs and small businesses
Entrepreneurial marketing, innovation, technology and entrepreneurship
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course schedule. Midterm and final exam dates are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of the University Senate.
